problem: vCPU is used earlier in Section 2 and throughout the example and quiz, but never defined; a first-time reader may not know it is a share of a physical core.
fix: On first use: 'more vCPU (virtual CPUs, the processor shares handed to each VM) than the provider owns'.

problem: LUN, NFS export, VLAN and overlay network are used as if already known; LUN in particular is jargon for block storage volumes.
fix: Expand briefly: 'datastores built from LUNs (block volumes presented over SAN) or NFS exports (shared folders over the network)' and 'VLAN segments (isolated layer-2 networks) or overlay networks (tunnels built in software on top of the physical network)'.

problem: 'compares the request against committed capacity minus reservations' is ambiguous and can be misread as subtracting reservations from the request.
fix: Say: 'Admission control adds the new request to what is already committed, keeps every pool's reservation satisfied, and refuses only if a guarantee would break. It does not look at the free memory of that instant.'
